facts.text: Serve the snacks when the crew stumble out of two years in stasis and Vickers drops for push-ups.
facts.why: The crew wake from stasis and David follows wet footprints into Vickers's suite, where she is doing push-ups; the scene is also the Comic-Con footage Wikipedia mentions.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when the crew wake from two years in stasis aboard the Prometheus.

facts.why: Vickers is never shown eating; David only says her separate module has its own life support, air and food.
facts.fix: Vickers's pick, from the food stores in her private module.
facts.full: Vickers's pick, eaten alone in her private module.

facts.why: On landing Holloway says it is Christmas and he wants to open his presents, and David's Christmas tree is up when the crew wake.
The film is set in 2093 and the crew land on Christmas, as Holloway says in the landing scene.

vibe.verdict: A smart airline galley that nails the Christmas tree and Lawrence of Arabia gags, but it stays polite for a film about a very bad dinner party.

ideas: Swap 'Hummus with warm flatbread' for 'Squid in a pastry blanket' as a nod to Shaw's surgery table scene.
Swap the plain 'Weyland Corporation Expedition' venue line for the Weyland TED talk quote about the future, as a menu header.
Add a dish called 'Fifield's melted helmet jelly' to the sweets to give the food some horror bite.
Swap 'Peated single malt, neat' for 'Janek's squeezebox tune' as a drink name, to use the accordion on the bridge.
